conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced was found: the Q2 bookings bar is the company's own ~EUR370m guide (set after Black Flag Resynced's launch), the FY guide's back-end dependence on licensing deals is public (BNP 22/10, Bernstein 24/07) and already sold into, and a 9.5% disclosed short offsets it; so the findings net to 0.0, p_up sits at 49 and only abs_move_pct is large (9%), because the release carries new H1 P&L, H1 free cash flow, a Q3 guide and a FY guide that has been cut at this company before.

bar: Q2 2026-27 net bookings of around EUR370m, Ubisoft's own guide (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/MKW/2026/07/FCMKW114163_20260723.pdf); the pre-guide FactSet consensus was EUR399.3m (https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/ubisoft-falls-as-video-game-maker-holds-guidance-despite-ac-black-flag-success-4810667?ampMode=1); no post-guide consensus found, so the bar for the H1 P&L and cash lines is unsourced and findings on them are capped small
session_check: amc - the issuer's investor page lists 'H1 Sales & Earnings' on November 19, 2026 with no time (https://www.ubisoft.com/en-us/company/about-us/investors); every scheduled Ubisoft results release in the AMF flux since 2024 was filed after the Paris close (H1 2024-25 2024-10-30T16:40Z, Q3 2025-02-13T16:40Z, FY 2025-05-14T15:40Z, Q1 2025-07-22T15:40Z, Q3 2026-02-12T16:40Z, FY 2026-05-20T15:40Z, Q1 2026-07-23T15:45Z with the call at 18:15 Paris), the only exception being the postponed H1 2025-26 at 07:40Z after a trading suspension (https://www.info-financiere.gouv.fr/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/flux-amf-new-prod/records?where=identificationsociete_iso_cd_isi%3D%22FR0000054470%22). Inferred from the pattern, not from a timestamp on this release: the window that holds the reaction is most likely the 2026-11-19 close to the 2026-11-20 close.
positioning_check: AMF register read (covered: true): 9.52% of capital disclosed short across 9 sellers as of 2026-11-16, down from 9.76% ten days earlier, so slightly covering, not building (https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/r/c2539d1c-8531-4937-9cba-3bd8e9786cc5). Goldman Sachs threshold filings show it moving around 10% of capital since early October with 2.2-4.2m shares held through stock lent with a right of recall, which is the lending side of that short (AMF decisions 226C1744 through 226C2021).

findings.finding: The Q2 bar is Ubisoft's own ~EUR370m guide, set on 23 July after Black Flag Resynced had already 'exceeded annual expectations' in 14 days; Ubisoft beat its Q1 guide by about 2%, so a small Q2 beat is likelier than a miss, but it lands inside guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026-27 beat its guide slightly (255.8 vs ~250) and the stock fell (Yahoo bar 2026-07-23 -14%, Investing.com 'more than 4%' on 07-24) because the Q2 guide was below consensus; Q3 2025-26 bookings beat with targets confirmed, +12.4% next day (2026-02-13).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the guide is public and the launch data predate it. What is not priced is only the size of a beat; if the market expected a large beat, the stock would not have drifted 13% lower over 20 sessions into the print.
findings.independence: Investing.com 24/07: Q1 255.8 vs consensus 254.8 and Q2 guide 7% below the EUR399.3m consensus (https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/ubisoft-falls-as-video-game-maker-holds-guidance-despite-ac-black-flag-success-4810667?ampMode=1)

findings.finding: The FY2026-27 guide needs H2 net bookings of roughly EUR740-760m against ~EUR626m for H1, on a slate of Rayman Legends Retold (slipped to 3 December) and Just Dance plus licensing deals that BNP says are concentrated at year end. That makes the reconfirmation at H1 the main tail risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide cuts or resets at Ubisoft: -14.0% (2024-07-19), -18.2% (2025-05-15), -39.8% (2026-01-22). Unchanged guides were sold in May and July 2026 (-2.3% on 2026-05-21; July as above). Confirmation with a beat paid +12.4% in Feb 2026.
findings.original_quote: les prévisions annuelles, qui reposent en grande partie sur des accords de licence et dont la réalisation est concentrée sur la fin de l'exercice, restent une source d'incertitude (the annual forecasts, which rest largely on licensing agreements and whose delivery is concentrated at the end of the fiscal year, remain a source of uncertainty)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock fell 8.2% on this note and is down 18.7% over 60 sessions, with 9.5% of the capital short. It would be fully priced if H1 brought no reconfirmation at all, so the residual is only the gap between a cut and a reconfirmation. Sized small because it argues the same way as a crowded short.
findings.independence: Bernstein (Peterc) on 24/07: 'This is where the numbers stop adding up', a below-consensus Q2 guide with an unchanged FY (https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/ubisoft-falls-as-video-game-maker-holds-guidance-despite-ac-black-flag-success-4810667?ampMode=1); Rayman delay (https://gematsu.com/2026/09/rayman-legends-retold-delayed-to-december-3)

findings.finding: Ubisoft has said since May that its review of financing options for upcoming maturities is 'actively progressing', and the AMF flux shows no financing transaction filed since; the H1 release is the natural place for an update on the 2027 bond.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Tencent/Vantage completion (2025-11-21, filed alongside H1 2025-26) came with a +3.9% day; earlier bond placements were sold (optionfinance 'Ubisoft chute après son émission obligataire', undated in snippet).
findings.why_not_priced: Whether anything lands is unknown. A cash-preserving refinancing would remove the refinancing risk BNP cites as unpriced; an equity-linked deal would dilute. The sign is close to zero and the range is wide.

findings.finding: Goldman Sachs' AMF threshold filings show it holding 2.2-4.2m Ubisoft shares through stock lent with a right of recall (up to about 3% of capital), on top of a 9.52% disclosed net short that has been covering slightly: borrowed supply that a non-negative print would have to be covered against.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-11-04/05 sessions rose +8.7% and +5.1% on a Bloomberg report of an Arkane bid, an outsized move for that news on a crowded short.
